name: Liquid Inference
description: Liquid Inference model provider: an auction exchange for LLM inference, with a price cap on each request

capUsd.label: Cap per request (USD)
capUsd.help: The most that one model request may cost. A task sends several requests, so this does not limit the total charge.

baseUrl.label: Exchange URL
baseUrl.help: The exchange's OpenAI-compatible endpoint, with /v1 at the end.

headers.label: Extra headers
headers.help: Headers added to every request, such as a purchasing rule.

capUsd.description: The most that one model request may cost, in USD. Default 1.

baseUrl.description: The exchange's OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Default https://router.inference.ai.exchange/v1.

headers.description: Extra headers on every request, such as a purchasing rule. One with the name of a default header replaces it.
